  "chunks": [
    {
      "chunk_type": "isnad",
      "arabic_text": "أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ",
      "translations": {
        "en": "Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isa from Mansur from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:"
      }
    },
    {
      "chunk_type": "body",
      "arabic_text": "سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُشَارِكُهُ الرَّجُلُ فِي السِّلْعَةِ قَالَ «إِنْ رَبِحَ فَلَهُ وَإِنْ وُضِعَ فَعَلَيْهِ».",
      "translations": {
        "en": "I asked him about a man who shares with another man in a commodity. He said: 'If there is profit, it is for him; if there is a loss (deficit), it is upon him.'"
      }
    },
    {
      "chunk_type": "body",
      "arabic_text": "الَّذِي بِأَيْدِيهِمَا وَأَحَالَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا بِنَصِيبِهِ مِنَ الْغَائِبِ فَاقْتَضَى أَحَدُهُمَا وَلَمْ يَقْتَضِ الْآخَرُ قَالَ «مَا اقْتَضَى أَحَدُهُمَا فَهُوَ بَيْنَهُمَا مَا يَذْهَبُ بِمَالِهِ».",
      "translations": {
        "en": "The one who is present with them, and each of them has allocated his share from the absent partner, and one of them claimed (the debt/share) while the other did not claim: He said: 'What one of them claimed is between them, according to what removes his wealth.'"
      }
    }
  ],
  "translations": {
    "en": {
      "summary": "This hadith outlines the rules of partnership (shirkah) in trade, specifically regarding profit and loss distribution. It states that profits belong to the partner who actively managed the transaction, while losses are shared proportionally. It further clarifies that if one partner claims a debt on behalf of the partnership while the other does not, the claim is valid for both according to their shares.",
      "seo_question": "How are profits and losses distributed in Islamic partnership trade when one partner is active and the other is absent?",

        "السِّلْعَة": "Commodity/Goods",
